candidate_relations.reason: The immunophenotyping (CD138+, CD56+, CD20-, PAX5-) and FISH findings (BCL6, MYC, IGH gains) are highly characteristic of plasmablastic lymphoma, not NK/T-cell lymphoma. While EBV-positive, the other markers conflict with NK/T-cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The candidate specifies NK/T-cell lymphoma, while the reference is plasmablastic lymphoma.
